routes.label: Move the decimal point three places

question: Calculate: \(3500\div1000=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
solution: Dividing by \(1000\) moves the decimal point three places to the left. Thus 3500 is exactly 3.5 thousands, and \(3500\div1000=3.5\).
